identity.title: Learning Formal Mathematics From Intrinsic Motivation

problem.claim: The paper explores whether an agent can discover mathematics from axioms by jointly conjecturing problems and proving theorems.

contributions.claim: An agent that jointly learns to pose challenging conjectures and solve them.
A constrained-decoding and type-directed-synthesis approach for sampling valid conjectures in dependent type theory, with well-formedness guaranteed by construction.
Novel hindsight relabeling methods for proof-search trees intended to improve sample efficiency in conjecturing and proving.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors identify their hindsight-relabeling methods on proof-search trees as novel.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The method guarantees well-formed conjectures by construction, including when initialized randomly.
Authors report experiments across propositional logic, arithmetic, and group theory showing bootstrap from axioms and self-improvement in generating true, challenging conjectures and finding proofs.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper frames mathematics as discovery from axioms through conjecture and proof.
It introduces an agent that learns conjecturing and theorem proving jointly, with proof ability changing the difficulty target.
For dependent-type-theory domains, constrained decoding and type-directed synthesis generate valid conjectures, guaranteed well formed by construction.
The same model supplies policy and value functions, while hindsight relabeling is used to improve sample efficiency in both tasks.
Experiments in three axiomatic domains are reported to show bootstrapping and self-improvement.

source_observation.claim: The abstract aligns its central self-improvement claim with a concrete mechanism: well-formed conjecture generation, proof-search guidance, and experiments across three axiomatic domains.

lessons.interpretation: A learning system's story is more informative when the claimed capability is connected to enforceable structural constraints and a defined evaluation setting.
lessons.application: When presenting an autonomous reasoning system, pair the capability claim with the mechanism that enforces valid outputs and name the domains used to demonstrate it.
lessons.exception: This framing is unsuitable when validity cannot be structurally enforced or when the work is purely theoretical without an evaluation setting.

unknowns: The abstract does not provide quantitative results, baselines, training details, or definitions of “hard,” “true,” and “challenging.”
It does not specify the exact form or comparative effect of the hindsight-relabeling methods.
